name: tala-project-tooling
description: Repository commands and pinned documentation/browser verification tools; not an application backend.

scripts.check: npm --prefix "planning/prototype as web app" run check && node tools/check-docs.cjs
scripts.docs:generate: node tools/generate-reference.cjs && node tools/prepare-backup-schema.cjs && node tools/build-wireframes.cjs
scripts.test:browser: node "planning/prototype as web app/tests/verify.cjs" && node "planning/prototype as web app/tests/verify-map.cjs" && node "planning/prototype as web app/tests/verify-revisions.cjs"
